interfaces.note: Adapted from the official Nordic ble_app_uart example (SDK 17.1.0 / S132 7.2.0). Real I2C via the official nrf_drv_twi master; real NUS notifications; async epoch/request-id binding in app_policy.c. MCU identity conflict (paper Fig.3 STM32WB15CC vs Methods nrf52832) is NOT resolved: this is a declared nRF52832 reconstruction. BLE UUID/frame protocol not published -> declared reconstruction. Target build success is NOT evidence of radio, I2C device/bus, GPIO or power.

pins.twi_scl_note: NEW dev-board assumption (PCA10040 Arduino header). The original pin mapping was NOT published; this is NOT the original mapping.
